$comment: Portable, language-agnostic starting catalog. Copy/seed this into the target project (translated into whatever the project's mapper module loads: JSON, YAML, a dict/object literal, etc). Extend 'patterns' with project-specific cases as they're discovered — do not hardcode them into the mapper function itself.
